title: Pachmarhi Weekend Getaway
overview: Embark on a magical group getaway to Pachmarhi, the Queen of Satpura, with TripWithMe as your trusted companion. Nestled in the heart of the Satpura Range, this scenic retreat offers lush forests, serene waterfalls, and breathtaking views. Kick off the adventure with a lively pool party with DJ, followed by a thrilling gypsy safari through the wilds of Satpura. Evenings come alive with music nights, live performances, games, and unforgettable bonding under the stars. Explore iconic spots like Bee Fall, Dhoopgarh, Jata Shankar, and the beautiful Chouragarh Mahadev trek, all while we handle the details. Let TripWithMe guide you through a trip full of fun, adventure, and lifelong memories.

itinerary.title: Departure from Indore | Journey Begins
activities: As the sun sets, it's time to leave the city behind and begin an unforgettable journey to the Queen of Satpura – Pachmarhi.
Meet your fellow travelers, complete the boarding process, and get ready for an exciting adventure ahead.
Enjoy fun introductions, group bonding, music, and a lively atmosphere as we travel overnight.
Relax and unwind as we make our way through the scenic highways towards Pachmarhi.
Boarding Points:
📍 Indore – 10:00 PM | Radisson Square
📍 Bhopal – 3:30 AM | Lal Ghati & ISBT
📍 Pipariya – 6:00 AM

itinerary.title: Arrival at Pachmarhi | Explore the Queen of Satpura
activities: Wake up to the fresh mountain air of Pachmarhi, the beautiful Queen of Satpura, and get ready for an exciting day ahead.
Enjoy a delicious breakfast before beginning your unforgettable journey through nature and adventure.
Have fun and relax with an exciting pool party at the resort.
Complete your hotel check-in (early check-in is subject to availability), freshen up, and prepare for sightseeing.
Explore Pachmarhi's famous attractions, including Bada Mahadev, Gupt Mahadev, Green Valley, Pachmarhi Lake, and the optional Chauragarh Mahadev trek (subject to time and group preference).
After an adventurous day, enjoy a delicious dinner followed by a fun-filled music night, group games, and memorable moments with your fellow travelers at the resort.

Please Note: The sightseeing itinerary may change due to weather conditions, local authority restrictions, traffic, time constraints, or unforeseen circumstances. TripWithMe will make every effort to cover the planned attractions.

itinerary.title: Adventure continues | Gyspsy safari | waterfall | sunset point
activities: Start your morning with a refreshing breakfast and get ready for another day of adventure.
Check out from the resort and receive a quick briefing before heading out for the day's sightseeing.
Enjoy an exciting gypsy safari as you explore the lush forests and scenic landscapes of Pachmarhi.

Visit Pachmarhi's most iconic attractions, including Jata Shankar, Pandav Caves, Ramya Kund, Bee Fall, Jal Gali, Reechgarh, Adbhut Drashya (Amazing View), Forest Museum, and the famous Dhoopgarh Sunset Point. Later, relax and explore the vibrant cafés and local market.
After a delicious dinner, begin your journey back home with unforgettable memories, beautiful photographs, and new friendships.

itinerary.title: Returning home with memories and friends for life.
activities: Estimated Drop Points: Bhopal: 2:00 AM and Indore: 6:30 AM
Every journey has a destination, but the memories and friendships you made along the way will stay with you forever.
Thank you for traveling with TripWithMe. We hope this trip brought you unforgettable moments, breathtaking views, and stories you'll love to share.
We look forward to exploring many more destinations with you.
🌍 Until next time... ✨ Explore More. Spend Less. ✈️ Happy Travels!

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: If cancellations are made 60-30 days before the trip's start date, 10% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made 30 days before the trip's start date, 50% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made within 0-30 days before the trip's start date, 100% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. In case of unforeseen weather conditions or government restrictions, certain activities may be canceled, and in such cases, the operator will try his best to provide an alternate feasible activity. However, no refund will be provided for the same.
